context_length_exceeded_behavior.help_text: What happens when the prompt plus max tokens exceed the context window: truncate lowers max tokens to fit (the provider's default), error fails the request.
context_length_exceeded_behavior.label: When context is exceeded

dimensions.help_text: Length of the returned vectors. Not set uses the model's own length.
dimensions.label: Dimensions

frequency_penalty.help_text: Penalises tokens proportionally to how often they appear, reducing repetition.
frequency_penalty.label: Frequency penalty

logit_bias.help_text: Maps token ids to a bias from -100 to 100 that makes those tokens more or less likely.
logit_bias.label: Logit bias

logprobs.help_text: Return the log probability of each output token.
logprobs.label: Log probabilities

max_tokens.help_text: Upper limit on the tokens the model generates in one answer.
max_tokens.label: Max tokens

min_p.help_text: Only tokens at least this likely are considered. An alternative to Top P and Top K.
min_p.label: Min P

mirostat_lr.help_text: How fast Mirostat adjusts towards its target. Has no effect without a Mirostat target.
mirostat_lr.label: Mirostat learning rate

mirostat_target.help_text: Target perplexity for Mirostat sampling, which keeps output surprise near this value. Not set turns Mirostat off.
mirostat_target.label: Mirostat target

presence_penalty.help_text: Penalises tokens that have already appeared, encouraging the model to introduce new topics.
presence_penalty.label: Presence penalty

prompt_truncate_len.help_text: Cuts a longer chat prompt down to this many tokens by silently dropping its start.
prompt_truncate_len.label: Truncate prompt to

reasoning_effort.help_text: How much the model thinks before answering. More effort is slower and costs more.
reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning effort

reasoning_history.help_text: How the model's earlier reasoning is kept in the prompt of later turns. Models accept different values (e.g. DeepSeek V4 only interleaved); a value the model does not take is rejected.
reasoning_history.label: Reasoning history

repetition_penalty.help_text: 1 is no penalty; above 1 discourages repeated tokens, below 1 encourages them.
repetition_penalty.label: Repetition penalty

safe_tokenization.help_text: Special tokens typed in user content are never read as real special tokens, which guards against prompt injection. On by default where the model supports it; Truncate prompt to is not applied while it is on.
safe_tokenization.label: Safe tokenization

seed.help_text: Same seed and settings give repeatable answers where the provider supports it.
seed.label: Seed

stop.help_text: The model stops generating when it produces one of these.
stop.label: Stop sequences

task_type.help_text: What the embeddings are used for, so the provider can optimise them.
task_type.label: Task type

temperature.help_text: Controls randomness of responses. Lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative.
temperature.label: Temperature

top_k.help_text: Only the K most likely next tokens are considered.
top_k.label: Top K

top_logprobs.help_text: How many most likely tokens to return at each position. Needs log probabilities on.
top_logprobs.label: Top log probabilities

top_p.help_text: Nucleus sampling: only tokens whose cumulative probability reaches Top P are considered.
top_p.label: Top P

typical_p.help_text: Considers the most typical tokens whose cumulative probability is at most Typical P.
typical_p.label: Typical P

verbosity.help_text: How long and detailed the answers are.
verbosity.label: Verbosity
